solutions.title: Copy board then update
solutions.strategy: Read neighbor states from a snapshot of the original board and write the next state into the input board.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every cell counts up to eight neighbors once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The snapshot stores every original cell so updates do not affect later neighbor counts.

solutions.title: In-place state encoding
solutions.strategy: Store transitional states in the board so the original and next values can be decoded during a final pass.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell is processed once to encode the next state and once to normalize the encoded state.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop indexes and neighbor counters are stored outside the board.
